One set to watch; a person who keeps guard, especially one who guards a building, or the streets of a city, by night.

examples.text: The visits of the watchman to that (then) obscure and ill-inhabited neighborhood were more regulated by his indolence than his duty; and Clarence knew that it would be in vain to listen for his cry or tarry for his assistance.
